During Playwright testing, page.click(force=True) on qa-match-toggle did NOT fire the TouchableOpacity Responder in react-native-web headless; using el.click() via page.evaluate DID. This is a test-harness quirk, not a code defect (real users tapping a TouchableOpacity on native or in a real browser fire pointer events that Playwright's default click bypasses). No production impact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Playwright interaction quirk from iter95 is now understood: page.click(force=True) on the qa-match-toggle TouchableOpacity does not fire onPress in react-native-web headless Chromium. Use page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"qa-match-toggle\"]').click()") to trigger the tap reliably. The reconcile Modal, SKIP button, CREATE button etc respond fine to page.click(force=True) because they are simpler pressables. Auth bypass: POST /api/auth/login for token -> localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', token) -> page.goto('/quick-add'). Delete any pre-existing 'Home Depot' dealer before the test or the reconcile path won't fire (exact-match auto-selects).
